家計調査報告 1936–37

Kakei chōsa hōkoku (Report of the Household Budget Survey), 自昭和十一年九月至昭和十二年八月 (September 1936 – August 1937)
內閣統計局 (Cabinet Bureau of Statistics), 東京; issued by 東京統計協會, 30 March 1938 (昭和13年3月30日)

Every table is transcribed: the table of households allotted in the survey outline, the in-text tables of the summary of results, the statistical tables 第一表–第七表 (第五表–第七表 for the whole country and each of the ten cities), the table of households by city in the survey regulations, and the classification of income and expenditure; the prose, the charts and the account-book forms are not. Each spread was read once by Claude Sonnet 5.5 (Arabic figures). The national tables run over several spreads, each spread carrying half the columns or a block of rows: the pieces are joined into one table per printed table, with amounts (實數) and percentages (比例) as separate parts, and a check that no cell was lost or doubled. Decimal points printed as spaces or commas are written as normal figures and noted. Where a digit was ambiguous only between 3 and 8 and exactly one reading made a printed total reconcile, that reading is used and noted; other doubtful digits are marked [?] even where a total would suggest a reading, and printed totals that do not add up are kept as printed and noted. In 第七表 the 世帶人員 figures of the wage-earner rows for Tokushima and Yawata do not match the household numbers; a second reader confirmed the Tokushima figures as printed. The heavy bold type of the 總數 rows is often smudged. No errata slip was found in this copy. 169 of about 78,400 filled cells could not be read and are marked [?].
